name: Trevor Stevado
biography: Trevor Stevado is a security researcher and the founder of Loudmouth Security, with over 15 years of experience in the industry. In 2018, Trevor won a Black Badge in the IoT CTF at DEF CON 26, and since then he has been a regular contributor to IoT Village and is now one of the founders of the new Embedded Systems Village, where he continues to push the boundaries of embedded security Research.
